summary: Evidence Arena is a standalone DeepSeek Harness workbench that runs multiple model coding contenders in parallel, shows candidate diffs and review evidence, and applies a chosen result back to the workspace after user confirmation.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The repository is a standalone DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds an A/B workbench to compare multiple coding candidates. Evidence from the README and package manifest shows it orchestrates parallel Builder runs in isolated worktrees, collects deterministic gate/review evidence, supports preview and human verdict recording, and performs explicit two-phase promotion. This indicates a primary purpose of workflow automation/orchestration for model-based coding evaluation with optional repository writes.
